summary: The compliance review of the Digital Apps used by Vasant Bank identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The key findings include: (1) The product feature does not explicitly mention the contact details of the nodal grievance redressal officers being prominently displayed on the DLA (partner LSP apps), which is a medium severity issue. (2) The feature states that only the bank's own app, Vasant Loans, has been reported on the RBI CIMS portal, while the three partner LSP apps are not reported, which is a high severity issue. (3) The feature also fails to report the three partner LSP apps on the RBI CIMS portal, which is another high severity issue due to the deadline of June 15, 2025, for completing the reporting.
